highlights.title: One Filter button
highlights.detail: One Filter button replaces the five filter menus and Settings. Press f to open the panel.

highlights.title: One chip for each filter
highlights.detail: Each filter type shows as a chip under the period. Tap a chip to edit it, or × to remove it.

highlights.title: All filters in one place
highlights.detail: Show internal transfers and the Items options are in the Filter panel.
